snippet.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Wisdom of Sea and Sky | Coming July 30!
snippet.description:
Lugia and Ho-Oh storm your battles in #PokemonTCGPocket at 11PM PDT on July 29, 2025 

Two Legendary Pokémon from the Johto region change the tide of battle and brighten the skies in Wisdom of Sea and Sky, the latest expansion for Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket releasing on July 29, 2025, at 11:00 p.m. PDT! The mighty Lugia and Ho-Oh debut alongside adorable first-partner Pokémon Chikorita, Cyndaquil, and Totodile and famous Trainers from the Johto region.
